newsitem.title: UK: Leeds gets Virgin, JJB Sports stores.
newsitem.headline: Leeds gets Virgin, JJB Sports stores.

text.p: Two more British retail outlets announced plans to set up in the northern English city of Leeds.
The Virgin Group said it will open a Virgin music megastore -- its largest outside London -- and a JJB Sports said it planned a superstore.
The latest announcements come just two weeks after Harvey Nichols, the up-market London store, opened its first shop outside the capital in Leeds.
The Virgin Megastore will open in November and the JJB Sports store will start trading in the Spring, said Tops Estates, specialist investor in town centre shopping malls.
The two new stores will open on either side of the Albion Street entrance to the Bond Street Mall in the Leeds Shopping Plaza. JJB Sports' superstore will include a unique basketball shooting court.
